recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
recipes.summary: A hearty Italian vegetable soup with onion, carrot, celery, beans, green beans, and small pasta simmered in an herb-flecked tomato broth. Finish each bowl with parsley, a pinch of red pepper flakes, and optional Parmesan.

recipes.title: Homemade Mac N Cheese Dry Mix
recipes.summary: A pantry jar of cheddar cheese powder, nutritional yeast, and spices that stands in for boxed mac and cheese. Whisk the mix into any drained pasta with a splash of water or milk for a creamy sauce in minutes.
